simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶפְרָת (H672) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֶפְרָת (ʼEphrâth) means Ephrath , another name for Bethlehem ; First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 19.

definitions.usage: once (Psalm 132:6) perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman; Ephrath, Ephratah.
definitions.full: H672. Ephrath or Ephrathah אֶפְרָ֫תָה proper name (see Sta § 308 d. 1; 342 d. 2; Morgenl. Forsch. 215 ) — might in several cases, e.g. Gen 35:16 , be אֶפְרָת + ה locative, but see Ruth 4:11 ; — 1. proper name, of a location place near Bethel, where Rachel died & was buried Gen 35:16 , 19 ; 48:7 ( אֶפְרָת only 48:7 where ה perhaps dropped on accusative of ה following (Ol); in last two passages לחם בית הוא is a gloss, see Di; compare 1Sam 10:2 ). 2 id. , a name of Bethlehem Micah 5:1 ; Ruth 4:11 ; compare perhaps אֶפְרָתָ֑ה כָּלֵב 1Chr 2:24 ( ᵐ5 ἦλθεν Ξαλὲβ εἰς Ἐφράθα ). 3 id. Psa 132:6 , perhaps applied to district where Kirjath Jearim lay, on the border of Judah & Benjamin, compare De Che. 4. proper name, feminine אֶפְרָת name given to wife of Caleb 1Chr 2:19 = אֶפְרָתָ֑ח 2:50 ; 4:4 .
